title: 第3章 家人第4章 进入基因库
slug: 神话纪元开局三寸石猴基因

“该怎么开口……”
季知行站在家门口，停顿了数秒，掏出钥匙，插入锁孔。
“咔嚓。”
门开了。
“哥，你回来啦！”一个清脆的声音立刻响起。
穿着洗得有些发白的粉色家居服的女孩从客厅走过来，正是他的妹妹季知雨。
她今年刚上初二，个子还没完全长开，有些瘦小，但眼睛很亮，笑起来有浅浅的酒窝。
“书包给我。”季知雨很自然地伸手。
季知行下意识地将单肩包递过去，目光却越过妹妹的肩膀，看向屋内。
客厅不大，陈设简单，但收拾得很干净。
父亲季国栋果然已经回来了，正坐在那张用了十几年的沙发上看电视。
听到开门声，他抬起头，露出笑容：“知行回来了，外头戒严，没受影响吧？”他声音有些沙哑，带着烟嗓。
“没有，我们放学就直接回来了。”季知行换了鞋，走进屋中。
桌上已经摆好了菜。
一碟清炒时蔬，一碟咸菜炒豆干，还有一小盘酱肉。
明天是他去选择基因的大日子，母亲显然特意加了菜。
厨房里传来油烟机的嗡嗡声，母亲张玉兰探出头，额头上有些细汗，笑容却温婉：“先去洗洗手，最后一个菜马上好。今天特意买了排骨，给你炖了汤。”
“哥，你想好明天选什么基因了吗？”季知雨放好书包，凑过来，眼睛发亮，“我觉得猛禽类基因最好，哥你觉醒的是二阶基因窍，选猛禽类基因，不用等晋升四阶晨星级，就有几率获得飞行能力。”
季知行身体一僵。

季国栋也看了过来，眼中满是期许：“知行，别紧张，按你自己的想法选，主要还是看契合度。”
“爸……”季知行张了张嘴，话却卡在喉咙里。
“吃饭了！”张玉兰端着热气腾腾的排骨汤从厨房走出来，招呼道，“都过来坐。知行，快来，这汤炖得久，骨头都酥了，最补身体。”
“嗯。”季知行点点头。
一家人围坐在不大的方桌旁。季知行刚坐下，一双筷子就夹着一片厚实的酱肉，放进了他碗里。
“来，知行，多吃点。明天是你人生中最大的日子，吃饱了，养足精神。”张兰笑看着他，眼角的鱼尾纹都舒展开来。
记忆的碎片涌上心头。
过去的两年半，这样的场景几乎每天都在上演。
家里做的好吃的，几乎都会进入他的肚子。
他总是理所当然地接受着最好的那份。
妹妹虽然偶尔会眼巴巴看着，却也很懂事地从不争抢。
“我真不是个东西！”季知行心里狠狠骂了自己一句。
“如果我真觉醒了二阶基因窍，将来能给家人好日子过，那也罢了。可这一切……”
他攥紧了筷子。
“可这一切，都是建立在我的谎言之上！”
他拿起筷子，从距离自己最近的碗里，夹起最大的一块排骨，放到了季知雨碗里。
桌上三人都愣住了。
季知雨诧异地看着碗里多出来的那块排骨，又抬头看向哥哥。
张玉兰和季国栋也停下筷子，有些惊讶地看着儿子。
“我基因窍已经彻底稳定了，以后用不到像以前那样大补。”

季知行努力让自己的声音听起来自然些，又夹了一块放到母亲碗里，再给父亲夹了一块。
“知雨你正长身体，太瘦了，以后多吃点肉。爸妈你们也多吃点，别总省给我。”
饭桌上安静了几秒。
季知雨看了看季知行，小声说了句“谢谢哥”。
张玉兰看着碗里的排骨，又看看儿子，眼睛有些湿润。

"How should I speak..."
Ji Zhixing stood at the door of his home, paused for a few seconds, took out the key and inserted it into the keyhole.
"Click."
The door opened.
"Brother, you're back!" A crisp voice immediately sounded.
The girl wearing a pink housecoat that was washed out and turned white came from the living room. It was his sister Ji Zhiyu.
She has just entered the second grade of junior high school this year, and her height has not yet fully grown. She is a little thin, but her eyes are bright and she has shallow dimples when she smiles.
"Give me the schoolbag." Ji Zhiyu stretched out his hand naturally.
Ji Zhixing subconsciously handed over the shoulder bag, but looked over his sister's shoulder and looked into the house.
The living room is not big, the furnishings are simple, but it is kept clean.
As expected, his father, Ji Guodong, had returned and was sitting on the sofa he had used for more than ten years, watching TV.
Hearing the sound of the door opening, he raised his head and smiled: "Zhixing is back, and there's a lockdown outside, so it's not affected, right?" His voice was a little hoarse, with a smoky voice.
"No, we came back directly after school." Ji Zhixing changed his shoes and walked into the house.
Dishes are already placed on the table.
A plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables, a plate of stir-fried dried tofu with pickles, and a small plate of soy sauce meat.
Tomorrow is the big day for him to select genes, and his mother has obviously added special ingredients.
The hum of the range hood came from the kitchen. My mother, Zhang Yulan, poked her head out. There was a little sweat on her forehead, but her smile was gentle: "Go and wash your hands first. The last dish will be ready soon. I bought ribs today and made soup for you."
"Brother, have you decided which gene to choose tomorrow?" Ji Zhiyu put down his schoolbag and came over, his eyes bright, "I think the raptor gene is the best. Brother, you are awakening the second-level gene orifice. If you choose the raptor gene, you will have a chance to gain the ability to fly without waiting to advance to the fourth-level Morning Star."
Ji Zhixing's body stiffened.
Ji Guodong also looked over, his eyes full of expectations: "Zhixing, don't be nervous, choose according to your own ideas, the main thing is to see the fit."
"Dad..." Ji Zhixing opened his mouth, but the words were stuck in his throat.
"It's time to eat!" Zhang Yulan came out of the kitchen with steaming pork rib soup and greeted, "Come and sit down. Zhixing, come quickly. This soup has been simmered for a long time and the bones are crispy. It is the best for the body."
"Yeah." Ji Zhixing nodded.
The family sat around a small square table. As soon as Ji Zhixing sat down, a pair of chopsticks picked up a thick piece of sauced meat and put it into his bowl.
"Come on, Zhixing, and eat more. Tomorrow is the biggest day of your life. Eat enough and be energetic." Zhang Lan looked at him with a smile, and the crow's feet at the corners of his eyes stretched.
Fragments of memories came to mind.
Scenes like this have been happening almost every day for the past two and a half years.
Almost all the delicious food cooked at home goes into his stomach.
He always accepts the best as a matter of course.
Although my sister would occasionally watch helplessly, she was very sensible and never fought for it.
"I'm really nothing!" Ji Zhixing cursed himself in his heart.
"If I really awaken the second-level genetic aperture and can give my family a good life in the future, then that's it. But all this..."
He clenched his chopsticks tightly.
"But all of this is based on my lies!"
He picked up his chopsticks, picked up the largest piece of ribs from the bowl closest to him, and put it into Ji Zhiyu's bowl.
The three people at the table were stunned.
Ji Zhiyu looked at the extra piece of ribs in the bowl in surprise, then looked up at his brother.
Zhang Yulan and Ji Guodong also stopped their chopsticks and looked at their son in surprise.
"My genetic orifice has been completely stabilized. I won't need as much supplementation as before in the future."
Ji Zhixing tried hard to make his voice sound more natural, put another piece into his mother's bowl, and gave another piece to his father.
"Zhiyu, you are growing taller and are too thin. Eat more meat from now on. Parents, you should also eat more. Don't always save it for me."
The dinner table was quiet for a few seconds.
Ji Zhiyu looked at Ji Zhixing and whispered:He said "Thank you brother".
Zhang Yulan looked at the ribs in the bowl and then at her son, her eyes a little moist.
